items.title: PoCL 7.2 Released With Official OpenCL 3.0 Conformance On RISC-V & x86_64 CPUs
items.summary: The Portable Computing Language project is out today with PoCL 7.2 as this portable, MIT-licensed OpenCL implementation that runs across various CPU architectures as well as targeting other GPUs/hardware with LLVM back-ends. Notable with PoCL 7.2 is bringing official OpenCL 3.0 conformance on x86_64 and RISC-V processors...
items.title_zh: PoCL 7.2 发布，在 RISC-V 与 x86_64 CPU 上正式支持 OpenCL 3.0 一致性
items.summary_zh: Portable Computing Language 项目发布 PoCL 7.2，这是一款 MIT 许可证的便携式 OpenCL 实现，可运行于多种 CPU 架构并通过 LLVM 后端支持其他 GPU 与硬件。该版本最大亮点是在 x86_64 和 RISC-V 处理器上正式通过 OpenCL 3.0 一致性认证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: RISC-V 平台首次获得 OpenCL 3.0 官方一致性认证，扩展了其在异构计算与加速器领域的软件生态。

items.title: GCC 17 Now Supports Using -mtune=native -mcpu=native On RISC-V
items.summary: As a follow up to last month's article about patches being posted for enabling "-mcpu=native -mtune=native" support for RISC-V with the GCC compiler, that code is now merged for what will become the GCC 17.1 release in the early months of 2027...
items.title_zh: GCC 17 已合并 RISC-V 的 -mcpu=native 与 -mtune=native 支持
items.summary_zh: 继上月发布相关补丁后，使 GCC 编译器在 RISC-V 平台上支持 -mcpu=native 与 -mtune=native 参数的代码现已合并，将随 GCC 17.1 于 2027 年初正式发布。该功能允许编译器自动检测本地 CPU 特性并进行针对性优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: RISC-V 用户可直接利用本地 CPU 微架构优化编译，无需手动指定参数，提升开发便利性与性能。

items.title: Qualcomm introduces Dragonwing Q-2390 and IQ-2390 for consumer and industrial AIoT applications
items.summary: Qualcomm has announced the Qualcomm Dragonwing Q-2390 and IQ-2390 quad-core Cortex-A78/A55 processors for AIoT consumer, commercial and industrial applications. items.title: Radxa Linkr – A USB drive-sized IP KVM with USB-C, Ethernet, and WiFi support
items.summary: Radxa Linkr is a compact, USB flash drive-sized IP KVM that connects to the target through HDMI and USB for video, keyboard, and mouse emulation. The user can control it over USB-C, Ethernet, or WiFi client/access point, even before the OS is booted. The device does not require any specific apps, since all you need is a web browser. The company also highlights support for Tailscale VPN, two-factor authentication, and AI agents such as OpenClaw and Hermes. items.title: USB-C Deskradar – An ESP32-C3 ADS-B flight tracker with a 1.28-inch round display
items.summary: The USB-C Deskradar is an ESP32-C3-based, aviation-themed ADS-B flight tracker that tracks and displays live aircraft positions around your location on a sonar-style circular grid. A 1.28-inch round display and a 3D-printed enclosure provide a real-time view of flights around a configured location. items.title: Linux 7.4 To Improve Apple Silicon Audio Support & Its "Impossible" Power Management
items.summary: The Apple Silicon audio driver code within the Linux kernel is preparing to make use of the recent shared GPIO infrastructure for allowing multiple drivers / kernel components to nicely share the same GPIO lines. This should help clean things up in the mainline kernel for the Apple Silicon audio support and with a cleaner architecture than the current downstream Asahi Linux code...
items.title_zh: Linux 7.4 将改进 Apple Silicon 音频支持及其"不可能"的电源管理
items.summary_zh: Linux 内核中的 Apple Silicon 音频驱动代码将采用新引入的共享 GPIO 基础设施，使多个驱动和内核组件能够更优雅地共享同一 GPIO 引线。相比当前 Asahi Linux 的下游代码，新架构更简洁，有助于在主线内核中改善 Apple Silicon 音频支持。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 推动 Apple Silicon 在 Linux 上游的音频支持整合，简化 Asahi Linux 维护负担。

items.title: LLVM Developers Begin Debate Over AGENTS.md For Helping AI Agents
items.summary: LLVM developers have begun a discussion on whether the project should host an AGENTS.md file (and CLAUDE.md) in their Git repository for helping to guide AI agents...
items.title_zh: LLVM 开发者开始讨论为 AI 代理引入 AGENTS.md
items.summary_zh: LLVM 开发者近日讨论是否在项目仓库中托管 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md 文件，为 AI 编码代理提供开发指引。这一讨论涉及 AI Agent 在 LLVM 代码贡献、代码审查等流程中的角色定位与规范问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 开源项目开始系统性规范 AI 辅助编码流程，影响未来 AI 与编译器协作模式。

items.title: Linux 7.3 Now Disabling RandStruct Security Feature By Default If Rust Support Present
items.summary: While Rust programming language use may help with memory safety and other security advantages, the default Linux kernel configuration is now losing randomization of sensitive kernel structures if Rust support is present...
items.title_zh: Linux 7.3 在启用 Rust 支持时默认关闭 RandStruct 安全特性
items.summary_zh: Linux 内核默认配置发生变化：一旦启用 Rust 语言支持，原本用于随机化敏感内核结构的 RandStruct 安全特性将被默认关闭。尽管 Rust 有助于改善内存安全，但它与 RandStruct 之间似乎存在兼容性问题，迫使内核在两者之间做出取舍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: Rust 与内核结构随机化机制的兼容性仍待解决，可能削弱内核整体安全防护。

items.title: AVX-512 xor_gen For Linux Updated & Looking Real Good For RAID Arrays
items.summary: Being worked on the past few months for the Linux kernel has been an AVX-512 optimized version of xor_gen() that is used for generating and validating parity blocks such as with Linux's software RAID 5 and RAID 6 arrays. The latest iteration of AVX-512 xor_gen() was posted today and shows some impressive results on AMD Zen 5 hardware...
items.title_zh: Linux AVX-512 xor_gen 优化更新，RAID 阵列性能亮眼
items.summary_zh: 开发者数月来持续推进 Linux 内核 xor_gen() 函数的 AVX-512 优化版本，该函数用于软件 RAID 5/6 阵列的奇偶校验块生成与验证。最新一轮提交在 AMD Zen 5 硬件上展现出可观的性能提升。
items.why_it_matters_zh: AVX-512 加速可显著提升软件 RAID 奇偶校验效率，降低 CPU 占用。

items.title: GCC 17 Compiler Merges Initial Support For Intel/AMD AI Compute Extensions "ACE"
items.summary: Landing today in the GNU Compiler Collection (GCC) codebase is initial support for the AI Compute Extensions (ACEv1) as the initial work out of the x86 Ecosystem Advisory Group between Intel and AMD for a common matrix acceleration architecture for helping AI/ML workloads with future CPUs...
items.title_zh: GCC 17 合并对 Intel/AMD AI 计算扩展 ACE 的初步支持
items.summary_zh: GNU Compiler Collection 代码库今日合并了对 AI Compute Extensions（ACEv1）的初始支持，这是 Intel 与 AMD 通过 x86 生态系统咨询组共同推进的矩阵加速架构，旨在帮助未来 CPU 加速 AI/ML 工作负载。
items.why_it_matters_zh: Intel 与 AMD 联手定义通用矩阵加速标准，可能影响未来 AI 推理在 CPU 上的实现路径与生态格局。

items.title: GPIBee (UsbGpib V3) USB-to-GPIB adapter gains Ethernet (PoE), but launches as closed-source hardware
items.summary: Last December, we wrote about XyphroLabs’s UsbGpib open-source hardware, affordable, and portable USB-to-GPIB adapter designed for legacy GPIB/IEEE-488 instruments and offering modern hardware and software. At the time, the UsbGpib V3 was also in the works with Ethernet (PoE) support, and the good news is that it’s now available, but named GPIBee. The less good news is that while V1 and V2 were both open-source hardware products (and still are), the GPIBee has been released as closed-source hardware for reasons we’ll explain below. GPIBee specifications: Microcontroller – Not disclosed. But not the Microchip ATMega32U4 8-bit AVR MCU found in V2 since its USB interface is limited to 12 Mbps Host interfaces USB 2.0 (480 Mbps) Type-C port with support for four modes Full USBTMC (USB Test and Measurement Class) VXI-11 over USB-Ethernet (CDC NCM) linux-gpib native interface Prologix-compatible (++ commands) via CDC UART (virtual COM port) 10/100Mbps Ethernet RJ45 port [...] The post GPIBee (UsbGpib V3) USB-to-GPIB adapter gains Ethernet (PoE), but launches as closed-source hardware appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: UsbGpib V3 升级为 GPIBee，新增以太网与 PoE，但转为闭源硬件
items.summary_zh: XyphroLabs 推出 UsbGpib USB 转 GPIB 适配器，V3 版本更名为 GPIBee，新增以太网（PoE）支持，配备 USB 2.0 Type-C 接口并支持 USBTMC、VXI-11、linux-gpib 等协议。但与 V1/V2 开源不同，GPIBee 因商业考量转为闭源硬件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 经典仪器 GPIB 接口仍具实用价值，但开源硬件的商业化转型可能影响开发者社区的采用意愿。

items.title: Microduck – A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI experimentation and fun
items.summary: Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face have unveiled the Microduck, a 25 cm tall biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, a depth sensor, two motion sensors, and an articulated beak that can pick up objects. This follows the launch of the Reachy Mini desktop robot earlier this year that featured a Raspberry Pi CM4 module or could interface to a computer instead. In some ways, we may think of the Microduck as a Reachy Mini with legs, but the company says both are different products. The Reachy Mini targets human-robot interaction, while the Microduck focuses on motion/action, although it also features a microphone and a speaker for audio interaction. Microduck specifications: SoC – Rockchip RK3566 CPU – Quad-core Cortex-A55 processor @ up to 1.8 GHz GPU – Arm Mali-G52 NPU – 0.8 TOPS AI accelerator VPU 4Kp60 H.265/H.264/VP9 video decoder 1080p60 H.264/H.265 video encoder System Memory – 1GB RAM Storage [...] The post Microduck – A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI experimentation and fun appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: Lantronix Open-M 720G/520G – Ultra-compact LGA system-on-modules based on MediaTek Genio 720 and Genio 520 SoCs
items.summary: Lantronix Open-M 720G and 520G are compact (43x44mm) LGA system-on-modules (SoM) powered by 6nm MediaTek Genio 720 and Genio 520 SoCs, offering an AI performance of 10 TOPS, and designed for Edge IoT applications running low-power Vision AI and GenAI tasks. The Genio 720 dual-camera module ships with 8GB LPDDR5 and the Genio 520 single-camera module with 4GB LPDDR5. Both offer 128GB UFS storage, Gigabit Ethernet, optional WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, dual display support, audio inputs/outputs, USB 3.2/2.0 interfaces, PCIe Gen2 x1, and more. Lantronix Open-M 720G/520G specifications: SoC (one or the other) MediaTek Genio 520 (MT8371) CPU – 2x Cortex-A78 up to 2.2GHz, 6x Cortex-A55 up to 2.0 GHz GPU – Arm Mali-G57 MC2 up to 880 MHz VPU Video Decode – Up to 1920 x 1200 @ 60fps Video Encode – Up to 1920 x 1200 @ 60fps ISP – 1x ISP NPU – NPU850 AI accelerator [...] The post Lantronix Open-M 720G/520G – Ultra-compact LGA system-on-modules based on MediaTek Genio 720 and Genio 520 SoCs appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: $299 Arduino Ventuno Q SBC combines Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 SoC and STM32H5 MCU
items.summary: The Arduino Ventuno Q is a single board computer pairing a Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 (IQ-8275) octa-core Edge AI SoC with an STM32H5F5 Arm Cortex-M33 microcontroller for real-time I/Os. First introduced at Embedded World 2026, the Ventuno Q is the second Qualcomm-based Arduino board after the Arduino UNO Q launched in October 2025. It’s quite a different beast with a larger design featuring 16GB LPDDR5, 64GB eMMC flash, an M.2 socket for NVMe storage, 2.5GbE and Wi-Fi 6 networking, a 4K-capable HDMI output, and two USB 3.2 ports, while still offloading real-time I/O to a Cortex-M33 microcontroller. Arduino Ventuno Q (ABX00181) specifications: SoC – Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 (IQ-8275, also known as QCS8275): CPU – Octa-core Kryo Gen 6 (Arm Cortex-A78/A55) processor GPU – Adreno A623 AI accelerator -Hexagon Tensor AI Processor (NPU) up to 40 dense TOPS ISP – Qualcomm Spectra 692/690 ISP Microcontroller (MCU) – STMicro STM32H5F5 CPU core – [...] The post $299 Arduino Ventuno Q SBC combines Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 SoC and STM32H5 MCU appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
